title: Compile Governed Domain Models
scope: Transform one closed, owner-qualified AlchLang domain model into deterministic, traceable target-neutral construction projections while preserving unsupported meaning and authority limits.
outcome: A system builder receives a reproducible compilation plan whose every emitted construct traces to declared domain meaning and whose unsupported constructs remain explicit blockers.
exclusions: Inferring field types, permissions, or behavior from identifiers or prose similarity
Embedding domain-specific test bodies or tool behavior in the general compiler core
Calling generated TypeScript, a graph, or passing tests canonical admission or runtime authority
Replacing a DomainSpec v2 authored source, construction binding, or conformance owner
challenge_route: Owner review must resolve carrier-v2 semantics, extension boundaries, and the target-neutral output contract before DomainSpec authoring begins.
claim_limit: This record proposes product meaning only. It is not accepted, admitted, implemented, conformant, released, or production-ready.
